verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own page says the H200 delivers its gains (e.g., up to 1.9X Llama2 70B inference over H100) "within the same power profile as the H100." That implies better performance per watt, but it is a relative vendor claim with no stated wattage figure for the SXM part. missing for 10: a documented numeric power envelope/TDP for H200 SXM, independent or hands-on performance-per-watt testing, and evidence on sustained-workload power and thermal behavior.
